image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution image of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The subject displays an elongated, oval body with visible segmentation on its dorsal surface, consistent with the eight overlapping plates characteristic of the species. The texture appears rough and calcareous, blending somewhat with the surrounding rock due to camouflage coloration (greens, browns, greys).

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral capability, not a static visual feature. Furthermore, the animal is currently adhered to a rock, not dislodged or curled.
